        (sum_of_digits(result[i]) < sum_of_digits(result[j]) ||

    // Helper function to calculate sum of digits
    method sum_of_digits(n: int) returns (s: int)
        requires n >= -1 // To avoid negative numbers in sum of digits
        ensures s >= 0 // Sum of digits is always non-negative
        ensures s == sum_of_digits_in(n) // The sum of digits is correctly calculated

    // Helper function to find the original index of an element
    method index_of(x: int, seq: seq<int>) returns (index: int)
        requires x in seq // x must be in the sequence
        ensures 0 <= index < |seq| && seq[index] == x // The index is valid and points to x in the original list
```
